factions.name: Bird
factions.desc: Hawks, owls, eagles, harpies — winged mortals.

factions.name: Eldritch
factions.desc: Cosmic horrors, abyssal entities, otherworldly madness.

factions.name: Corrupted
factions.desc: Tainted beings, fallen heroes, infected by corruption.

factions.name: Spirit
factions.desc: Ghosts, wisps, ethereal echoes of the dead.

factions.name: Divine
factions.desc: Gods, avatars, primordial deities above the celestial.

factions.name: Champion
factions.desc: Tournament victors, legendary duelists, named heroes.

factions.name: Alien
factions.desc: Xenomorphs, parasites, things from beyond the stars. Carriers of the Infection.

factions.name: SCP
factions.desc: Catalogued anomalies, breached specimens, and the containment that holds them.

factions.name: Werewolf
factions.desc: Moon-cursed lycanthropes — man by day, monster when the moon rises.

statuses.name: Poison
statuses.desc: Takes 1-5 dmg/turn

statuses.name: Burn
statuses.desc: Takes 3 dmg/turn

statuses.name: Bleed
statuses.desc: Takes 2-4 dmg/turn

statuses.name: Siphoned
statuses.desc: Tendrils drain 3-6 HP/turn

statuses.name: Stunned
statuses.desc: Cannot act

statuses.name: Panicked
statuses.desc: Shaken after a nearby ally fell — -3 DEF and -25% accuracy for 2 turns.

statuses.name: Slow
statuses.desc: -1 movement, -1 attack range, -15% accuracy

statuses.name: Haste
statuses.desc: +1 movement

statuses.name: Weak
statuses.desc: -3 attack

statuses.name: Strong
statuses.desc: +4 attack

statuses.name: Shielded
statuses.desc: +5 def & res

statuses.name: Focused
statuses.desc: +4 magic

statuses.name: Frozen
statuses.desc: Cannot act

statuses.name: Asleep
statuses.desc: Skips turn; 35% chance to wake each turn

statuses.name: Confused
statuses.desc: 33% chance to hit self when attacking

statuses.name: Paralyzed
statuses.desc: -1 SPD (movement / attack range / accuracy); 25% chance to skip each action

statuses.name: Dispelled
statuses.desc: Cannot use moves that cost energy

statuses.name: Assisted
statuses.desc: +6 ATK and +6 MAG for the next strike

statuses.name: Spectral Haze
statuses.desc: 👻 Haunted by ghostly fog — every attack this unit makes MISSES until it clears.

statuses.name: Stumbling
statuses.desc: Tripped — skips their next turn

statuses.name: Protected
statuses.desc: Immune to all damage and effects until next turn

statuses.name: Countering
statuses.desc: Blocks the next enemy attack and counters back

statuses.name: Ambush Guard
statuses.desc: Watching (range 1) — reaction-strikes the first enemy that moves adjacent this enemy turn.

statuses.name: Ambush Guard
statuses.desc: Watching (range 3) — reaction-strikes the first enemy that moves within 3 tiles this enemy turn.

statuses.name: Raged
statuses.desc: Must attack the nearest enemy; can only use attack moves (+3 ATK, -2 DEF)

statuses.name: Corrupted
statuses.desc: Turned against its own — can ONLY attack allied units, and may only use attack moves.

statuses.name: Infected
statuses.desc: All stats reduced by 50% — ATK / MAG / DEF / RES / SPD halved

statuses.name: Happy
statuses.desc: Cannot attack the unit that applied this status (3 turns by default)

statuses.name: Following
statuses.desc: Can only move toward the unit that applied this status. Cannot attack anyone (1-3 turns)

statuses.name: Blessed
statuses.desc: +3 ATK / MAG / DEF / RES while blessed.

statuses.name: Cursed
statuses.desc: -3 ATK / MAG / DEF / RES while cursed.

statuses.name: Phantom Veil
statuses.desc: Illusory duplicates flicker around the unit — 50% chance to dodge any incoming attack.

statuses.name: Necrotic Bloom
statuses.desc: A necrotic infection that worsens — 3 dmg/turn × turns active (3, 6, 9, 12…). Cleanse to stop the spiral.

statuses.name: Mortal Sentence
statuses.desc: A death sentence with a countdown — when the timer expires, this unit dies. Cleanse to dispel.

statuses.name: Soul Anchor
statuses.desc: A tether to the living world — revives at 50% max HP the first time this unit would be KO'd.

statuses.name: Killer Instinct
statuses.desc: Each stack grants +2 ATK. Stacks build on KO; capped at 5 stacks (+10 ATK).

statuses.name: Knocked Down
statuses.desc: Shoved off balance and knocked prone — skips their next turn.

statuses.name: Off-Balance
statuses.desc: Stumbling from the impact — -2 movement/range and -2 DEF.

statuses.name: Knockback
statuses.desc: Shoves the hit target AWAY from the attacker. Status Duration = tiles pushed (1-4); Status Chance = proc %.

statuses.name: Grappling Hook
statuses.desc: Yanks the hit target TOWARD the attacker. Status Duration = tiles pulled (1-4); Status Chance = proc %.

statuses.name: Frostbite
statuses.desc: Freezing rot — 1-3 dmg/turn and -1 movement.

statuses.name: Scorched
statuses.desc: Charred plating — 2 dmg/turn and -3 DEF.

statuses.name: Hemorrhage
statuses.desc: A worsening wound — 2 dmg/turn × turns active (2, 4, 6…). Cleanse to stop it.

statuses.name: Electrified
statuses.desc: Crackling current — 1-3 dmg/turn and 30% chance to fumble each action.

statuses.name: Vulnerable
statuses.desc: -5 DEF & RES — armor and wards shattered.

statuses.name: Injured
statuses.desc: Deployed exhausted — takes DOUBLE damage from every source until the battle ends. Rest the hero to clear it.

statuses.name: Empowered
statuses.desc: +4 ATK and +4 MAG while empowered.

statuses.name: Swift
statuses.desc: +2 movement / attack range.

statuses.name: Petrified
statuses.desc: Encased in stone — cannot act, but +8 DEF & RES.

statuses.name: Disarmed
statuses.desc: -7 ATK — weapon knocked away.

statuses.name: Blinded
statuses.desc: Cannot see — 40% chance to fumble each action and -2 ATK.

statuses.name: Hexed
statuses.desc: -6 MAG and -3 RES — arcane channels fouled.

statuses.name: Berserk
statuses.desc: Blind fury — must attack the nearest enemy; +6 ATK, -5 DEF.

statuses.name: Entangled
statuses.desc: Bound by roots/webbing — cannot act until it breaks.

statuses.name: Dazed
statuses.desc: Head ringing — 30% chance to fumble each action and -1 movement.

statuses.name: Lucky
statuses.desc: Fortune shields the unit — 30% chance to dodge any incoming attack.

statuses.name: Reborn
statuses.desc: Recently returned to the battlefield from death.

statuses.name: Burning Resurrection
statuses.desc: Risen in flame — +4 ATK & +4 MAG while it burns.

statuses.name: Soul Flame
statuses.desc: Wreathed in soul-fire — +4 DEF & +4 RES while it lasts.

statuses.name: Frost Form
statuses.desc: Encased in frost: +4 DEF, +3 RES, -1 SPD. Fades after a few turns.
